'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Robbie Hendon LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Robbie Hendon]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Remembering Blake Huffman'''. Username '''rhendon'''. L49 Gungan/Gunga Gotta Grand Army → Wesa Gotta Grand Army.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' rhendon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
